C2C  (Consumer-to-Consumer)  Model  
Features
 
A  C2C  logistics  model  focuses  on  individuals  sending  goods  to  other  individuals,  similar  to:  
●  Parcel  delivery  ●  Personal  item  transport  ●  Local  courier  services  ●  Marketplace  delivery  ●  Friend/family  package  transfer  
 
1.  User  Account  Management  
Registration  &  Login  
●  Mobile  OTP  login  ●  Email/Phone  signup  
User  Profile  
●  Saved  addresses  ●  Contact  management  ●  Favorite  locations  
 
2.  Instant  Delivery  Booking  
Vehicle  Selection  
Users  can  choose:  
●  Bike  delivery  ●  Van  ●  EV  vehicles  
Delivery  Types  
●  Same-day  delivery  ●  Instant  delivery  ●  Scheduled  delivery  
 
3.  Pickup  &  Drop  Management  
Address  Input  
●  Google  Maps  integration  ●  Pin  location  
Multiple  Stops  
●  Multi-drop  deliveries  ●  Sequential  stops  
Delivery  Instructions  
●  Floor  details  ●  Fragile  item  note  
 
4.  Real-time  Tracking  
Live  Vehicle  Tracking  
●  Driver  live  location  ●  Estimated  arrival  time  ●  Route  visibility  
Trip  Status  
●  Driver  assigned  ●  Reached  pickup  ●  In  transit  ●  Delivered  
 
5.  Driver  Partner  Features  
Driver  Details  
●  Name/photo  ●  Vehicle  number  ●  Ratings  
 
6.  Package  Handling  Features  
Item  Categories  
●  Documents  ●  Electronics  ●  Furniture  ●  Appliances  ●  Clothing  ●  Gifts  
Fragile  Handling  
●  Fragile  tag  ●  Special  handling  instructions  
Weight  &  Size  Input  
●  Package  dimensions  ●  Estimated  weight  
 
7.  Fare  &  Pricing  Engine  
Pricing  Parameters  
●  Distance  ●  Vehicle  type  ●  Package  weight  
●  Peak-hour  surge  
Fare  Features  
●  Instant  fare  estimation  ●  Coupon  discounts  ●  Promo  codes  
 
8.  Payments  
Payment  Methods  
●  Cards  ●  Cash  ●  Pay-on-delivery  
Split  Payments  
Useful  for  buyer/seller  transactions.  
 
9.  Safety  &  Trust  Features  
OTP-based  Delivery  
●  Pickup  OTP  ●  Delivery  OTP  
Package  Verification  
●  Photo  upload  ●  Item  confirmation  
Safety  Features  
●  Driver  verification  ●  Emergency  support  
 
10.  Notifications  &  Alerts  
Customer  Alerts  
●  Driver  assigned  ●  Pickup  started  ●  Delivery  completed  
 
11.  Ratings  &  Reviews  
Customer  Feedback  
●  Driver  ratings  ●  Delivery  experience  
Driver  Reviews  
●  Customer  behavior  reporting  
 
12.  Support  &  Dispute  Resolution  
Customer  Support  
●  Chat  support  
Dispute  Resolution  
●  Damaged  goods  claims  ●  Missing  package  resolution
